audit.why: Win rate 54.15% over 5112 games, favourable for Malzahar.

Early is Lux's poke window (Q 1175 / E 1100 range vs Malz E 650); Malzahar takes over at 6 with point-click suppression on an immobile enemy; side lane and teamfights favour Malzahar's shove + R pick. Page reflects this.
Spikes: Lux 3-5 poke window; Malzahar 6 (Nether Grasp), first item (Liandry's), late. spikes[] has all 4 entries and matches.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named 'Iron Boundary' — Malzahar's passive is Void Shift; field also carried no cooldown numbers. Missing interaction: Lux's burst finishes with an Illumination (P) auto reset — the wind-up is the disengage cue.
audit.why: Kit file: Lux Q 10s flat, E 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, W 12-10, R 60/50/40; Malzahar Q 6s silence, R 140/110/80 point-click suppression Lux cannot break (no dash, no cleanse in kit).
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with real numbers; Illumination auto-reset tell added to report[5].

edits.before: - Lux Light Binding: matchup-defining — Everything keys off the root — minion-block it and her combo never starts. Check it before every step-up. - spell shield (Iron Boundary) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Light Binding: 10s cooldown at every rank — the matchup opens for 10 seconds each time it whiffs or is minion-blocked. - Lucent Singularity is 10s down to 8s; with both down she has no threat. - Void Shift is the lifeline; her Final Spark returns every 60/50/40s.
